verdict.rationale: OCI documents typical REST APIs, SDKs, a Terraform provider, and a CLI that 'provides the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands', which is a direct first-party parity claim. However, the claim is hedged to 'core' functionality, and the CLI is the interface named, not the API itself. missing for 10: explicit statement that every Console action is exposed via the REST API, documented list of any UI-only gaps, independent or hands-on corroboration of API/UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The CLI provides the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure APIs are typical REST APIs that use HTTPS requests and responses.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Terraform provider is a component that connects Terraform to the OCI services that you want to manage.
